about.title: Mafalda Amaro
about.intro1a: I am a person fascinated by dogs who has received the
about.school: Nordic Education Centre for Ethical Dog Training
about.intro1b: 's Certificate of Professional Ethical Dog Trainer by
about.intro2: I am currently studying at this school to obtain my diploma as a dog behaviour specialist and following a course by Dr. Amber Batson on Juvenile Dog Behaviour.
about.intro3: Following ethical, force-free training methods, science-based communication and enriched environments, I aim to help dogs and their caregivers achieve harmony through understanding and respect.
about.intro4: Until recently, I was also a regular volunteer at the local shelter, where I focused on reducing stress levels and giving dogs time to make choices, explore and learn to cope with their surroundings.
about.intro5a: This is a journey to be continued, a lifelong dream!
about.intro5b: I am ready to share what I have learnt so far
about.intro5c: and invite you to discover fascinating details
about.intro5d: that people often miss and that can make all the difference.
about.classesIntro: These are some of the classes I completed in 2025:
about.class1b: How Pain or Discomfort May Be Affecting Your Dog
about.summitTitle: Advanced Annual Online Summit Beyond Training:
about.summitSubtitle: Understanding the Dog Inside and Out
about.summitDescription: was a very enlightening experience. It was a great pleasure to learn from the speakers:
about.speaker1b: The Emotional Brain: How Stress and the Body Interact
about.speaker2b: The Body Talks: Using the Galen Comfort Scale to Understand Behaviour
about.closing: My wish is to keep learning about many things, but especially about dogs ;)

hero.title: Harmonious Living with Dogs
hero.intro1: Welcome to Calmafalda, where I help dogs and their caregivers thrive through respectful communication and enriched environments, attending to each individual dog's needs.
hero.intro2: Discover ethical, force-free guidance, adequate mental and physical stimulation and tailored advice for your furry friend. Struggling with behavioural issues? Let's reframe that together! It's never too late!
hero.intro3a: Learn what dogs are telling us.
hero.intro3b: Approach based on up-to-date scientific knowledge.
